quirks.case-keywords: keywords match only exact lower or UPPER case
quirks.case-aggregations: aggregations match only exact lower or UPPER case
quirks.case-operators: relational operators match only exact lower or UPPER case
quirks.case-null: NULL matches only NULL or null
quirks.case-time-units: time units match only exact lower or UPPER case
quirks.case-bool: BOOL also accepts True and False
quirks.multiword-spacing: multi-word tokens need exactly one space
quirks.multiword-case: multi-word tokens need one case throughout
quirks.first-rule-on-tie: on equal length, the rule listed first wins
quirks.precedence: NOT binds tighter than AND, which binds tighter than OR
quirks.decimal-sign: DECIMAL reuses INT's sign, so --3.5 lexes
quirks.whitespace: whitespace includes the Unicode spaces at PQLGrammar.g4:214, and nothing else
quirks.comment: # starts a comment, to the end of the line
quirks.one-element-array: the grammar actions reject a one-element array
quirks.syntax-no-span: syntax errors are PQL_PARSE_SYNTAX with no span
quirks.code-point-columns: columns count code points, as ANTLR's Python runtime does, from 0
quirks.lines: rows count lines from 1, ended by \n
quirks.end-col: end_col is the start column of the last token
quirks.int-bounds: integers are bounded by int64, window offsets by int32 (np.iinfo)
quirks.date-month-first: an ambiguous date is read month first
quirks.date-day-first-fallback: a date impossible month first is read day first, with a warning
